subject.title: [Bug]: Hallucination Loop — Agent Generated Irrelevant Multi-Thousand-Word Responses Across 2 Simultaneous Sessions

question: Should this incident be treated primarily as expected shared-DM configuration behavior, a Telegram/session-routing bug, a reconnect-drain delivery bug, or a new semantic runaway-output guard requirement?
rationale: The report crosses documented shared-DM defaults, Telegram delivery recovery, and model/session semantic behavior; source inspection does not identify one narrow implementation boundary that automation can safely choose.

options.title: Keep as incident tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open while using related issues for the reconnect-drain and compaction/intermediate-text subproblems, then close only after a maintainer-owned diagnosis or fix covers the exact incident.

options.title: Route to configuration support
options.body: Treat the report as expected shared-DM behavior and document or guide users toward `session.dmScope: "per-channel-peer"`, accepting that the semantic hallucination claim remains unproven.

options.title: Create a new guard design
options.body: Open a focused product/design task for semantic runaway-output detection and stop behavior across channel sessions before attempting code changes.

recommendation.title: Keep as incident tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while using related issues for the reconnect-drain and compaction/intermediate-text subproblems, then close only after a maintainer-owned diagnosis or fix covers the exact incident.
